full_prompt_en: A square old-master style oil portrait shows an elderly bearded man in profile taking a sip from a clear glass of amber beer against a deep brown interior background. The man's head and upper torso fill most of the right and central frame. He wears a small dark cap over thinning gray hair and a loose brown-gray coat that sinks into the surrounding shadow. His face turns left, eyes half closed, with a long nose and deeply lined brow brought out by warm side light. A full gray-white beard falls from his cheeks and chin, catching a few brighter strokes near its center. His raised hand occupies the lower left, thick fingers wrapped around a short straight-sided glass. A narrow band of pale foam rests on the dark golden liquid, and small reflections glint along the glass rim. The vessel meets his mouth, making the single gesture the focus of the scene. Behind him, the wall stays almost featureless, shifting subtly from warm umber to black at the edges. Broad, soft brushwork models the coat and background, while finer marks describe skin creases, beard strands, knuckles, and the transparent glass. Light arrives from the left and slightly above, striking the forehead, nose, hand, glass, and beard, then fading rapidly along the right shoulder and far side of the head. The amber drink supplies the only notable color lift within the restricted palette of brown, black, and warm cream. No readable text appears. The overall composition is close, earthy, and contemplative, using a small everyday action to hold attention amid dense shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典油画肖像呈现一名留胡须的老人侧身啜饮一杯琥珀色啤酒，身后是深棕色室内背景。他的头和上身填满右侧及中央大部分画面。稀疏灰发上戴着一顶小深色帽，宽松棕灰外套沉进周围阴影。脸转向左侧，眼睛半闭，长鼻与深刻额纹在暖侧光下突出。浓密灰白胡须从脸颊和下巴垂下，中央有几笔更亮的颜色。他举起的手占据左下，粗壮手指环住一只矮直壁玻璃杯。深金色液体上浮着一道窄浅色泡沫，玻璃杯沿闪着小反光。杯子碰到嘴边，使这个单一动作成为场景焦点。他身后的墙面几乎没有具体形态，从暖赭棕向画边的黑色微妙变化。宽而柔的笔触塑造外套与背景，更细的笔痕描绘皮肤皱纹、胡须、指节和透明玻璃。光从左上方来，照及额头、鼻子、手、杯子与胡须，随后沿右肩与头的远侧迅速衰减。琥珀色饮料成为棕、黑与暖奶油色的有限配色中唯一明显的色彩提亮。画中没有可读文字。整体构图紧凑、朴实而沉思，以一个细小的日常动作在浓密阴影中抓住注意力。
style_prompt_en: The oil-paint treatment uses a low-key umber and charcoal ground, with a narrow band of warm illumination picking out selected rounded volumes. Broad, blended dark strokes hold the peripheral space together; smaller textured touches concentrate where light meets skinlike, fibrous, or transparent surfaces. Deep shadows absorb contours rather than outlining every edge, making the brightest planes feel close and physical. Warm cream and muted gold rise from brown-black surroundings, while cooler gray notes moderate the highlights. Directional side light falls quickly, leaving a compact focal zone and generous darkness around it. The composition is close and weighted toward one gesture-sized cluster, with little descriptive background. The overall effect is earthy, intimate, and quietly theatrical, giving ordinary texture the dignity of careful tonal painting.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油彩表现使用低调赭棕与炭黑底色，以一道狭窄暖光挑出选定的圆润体积。宽阔、融合的深色笔触把外围空间联在一起；更小的纹理笔点集中在光遇上类肤质、纤维质或透明表面之处。深影吞没轮廓，而非沿所有边缘描线，使最亮的平面显得靠近且有实体。暖奶油色与低饱和金色从棕黑环境中浮起，较冷灰色则调和高光。定向侧光迅速衰减，留下紧凑焦点和周围宽裕的黑暗。构图紧贴一个动作大小的形态群，背景几乎没有描述。整体效果朴实、亲密而安静地带有戏剧性，让寻常纹理获得细致明度绘画的庄重感。
theme_en: An elderly bearded man taking a sip from a glass of amber beer
theme_zh: 一位白胡须老人举杯啜饮琥珀色啤酒
name: Adriaen Brouwer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
